title: Lab Integration Specialist
description:

Overview .

Overview of Services .

  • Participates in stakeholder program planning meetings to collect technical and integration requirements for the client's labs migration out of Brampton to new locations in Ontario.
  • Being single point of contact for resolving technical issues related to lab migration project.
  • Managing the integration of hardware and software systems within the lab environment.
  • Ensures that new hardware platforms, networking equipment, and test environments are properly installed, configured, and validated to meet engineering, testing, and wireline/wireless teams requirements.
  • Work with client's IP Engineering team to provide solution and evolve Lab unified IP and Network Security architecture and infrastructure.
  • Work with client's Cloud Engineering team to provide solution and evolve client's Lab Cloud architecture and infrastructure.
  • Work with Security team to implement new VPN solution in the Lab to replace Lab's legacy VPN infrastructure.
  • Work with various engineering teams to make sure various network services are migrated successfully out of Brampton labs.
  • Develop and maintain full inventory of IP flows and design documentation for client's Unified lab.
  • Work with stakeholders to ensure client's lab cyber security is maintained according to policy and governance set by clients Cyber Security team.
  • Support activity related to the integration and installation of new equipment in the lab.

Overview of Deliverables .
Supplier will provide the following Deliverables:

Lab BAU Activities
  • Maintain the existing labs footprint at Brampton HQ that includes current inventory, lab design, architecture at all levels of detail.
  • Perform duties related to commission/decommission of equipment, updating Rack layouts, Elevation, Power consumption, Physical and logical design, Business owners etc.
  • Helping in building documentation that identify interdependencies between different labs e.g. various feeds, network connections etc.
  • Keep a thorough assessment of our current on-premises infrastructure, including servers, storage systems, and networking components
  • Monitor changes and re-validate the results of the Lab Audit and formulate key outputs, gaps and challenges as additional equipment is installed in the Lab.
  • Updating CRE layouts during period site visits to correctly locate all the labs and test rooms.
  • As part of the lab management, maintain intake request, get approvals, and Tag all the equipment asset in the racks and with QR codes and identify the technology team and BU Ownerships.

Lab Technical Services Delivery Activities

Network Infrastructure Integration (Routers & Switches):
  • Rack and stack L2/L3 network devices (e.g., Cisco Catalyst/Nexus, Juniper EX/QFX, Arista) following rack elevation diagrams and cable management standards.
  • Perform console-based bootstrap configuration of new routers and switches, including hostname assignment, management IP configuration, and initial secure access (SSH, SNMP, TACACS).
  • Provision network topologies using:
    • VLAN tagging and trunk/access port setup
    • EtherChannel/LAG (LACP/Static)
    • STP/RSTP/MSTP configuration and loop prevention
    • Sub-interface setup and interface descriptions
  • Configure and validate routing protocols, including:
    • OSPF (area planning, adjacency, DR/BDR validation)
    • BGP (peering, route filtering, prefix-list, and policy-based routing)
    • Static routing and redistribution between protocols
  • Implement ACLs, NAT/PAT rules, and VRF-lite for traffic isolation across lab environments.
  • Perform image upgrades (e.g., IOS-XE, NX-OS, JunOS, EOS) using TFTP, SCP, or USB media.
  • Validate network performance and reachability using iPerf, traceroute, ping, and custom test scripts across lab segments.
  • Provide occasional support to client's SOC team in disabling TACACS/RADIUS accounts and migrating to RSA/Token based VPN services.

Server Hardware Integration (Bare Metal, Virtual & Container):
  • Rack, power, and cable enterprise and custom-built x86-based servers.
  • Configure server BIOS/UEFI settings, boot order, and apply firmware/driver updates via vendor tools (e.g., Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO).
  • Provision operating systems (Linux/Windows/ESXi) using PXE boot, kickstart, or cloud-init automation methods.
  • Establish IPMI/BMC access for remote management and integrate nodes into DCIM systems and monitoring dashboards.
  • Perform system validation (e.g., stress tests, memtest, burn-in tests) to confirm hardware integrity (RAM, CPU, NIC, HBA).
  • Install, configure, and validate hypervisors or bare-metal setups, and integrate with lab network environments for full-stack testing.

Lab Integration Testing & Validation:
  • Create and execute test plans to validate new hardware and network configurations before releasing lab access to engineering teams.
  • Perform packet-level validation using tools like tcpdump, Wireshark, or embedded diagnostics.
  • Simulate traffic scenarios or failure conditions (e.g., port flapping, link failure, routing reconvergence) for functional testing.
  • Validate network segmentation and isolation using VLAN probing and MAC address tables.
  • Maintain loopback addresses, management subnets, and NAT traversal logic for remote connectivity and remote debugging.

Automation and Tools:
  • Leverage scripting (Python, Bash) to automate repetitive provisioning tasks such as OS deployment, configuration templating, or network baseline validation.
  • Integrate lab assets with inventory/asset management systems (e.g. SnipeIT, Remedy, ServiceNow).
  • Participate in build-out of automation pipelines using Ansible, Terraform, or similar for network and server provisioning.

Lab Migration Activities – Planning
  • Collaborate with internal Lab primes to understand business requirements and technical considerations for the data center migration for the new locations.
  • Maintain ownership and end to end responsibility of scheduling and coordinating all core technical activities with the third party vendor during lab planning.
  • Act as an operational Interface to various stakeholders and vendors for RNOC,VFLAB, Wireless & Wireline Labs and all 18+ test Rooms.
  • Work with the vendor to build a comprehensive lab migration plan, step-by-step move process, timeline, and resource requirements.
  • Collaborate with IT/wireless/wireline teams and third-party vendors to coordinate the migration activities, ensuring unified execution.
  • Build a migration strategy that supports physical split , logical switching to allow seamless and sequential migration between Brampton and their associated new location.
  • Detailed 1 -1 Mapping of Source & Target Racks with respect to location, network & power and agreed physical layout.
  • Coordinate mapping activities with all the stakeholders and get their buy-in on the migration plan and strategy.
  • Advise on industry best practices and standards for the migration, ensuring smooth lift/shift to new location .

Lab Migration Activities – Prerequisite Check
  • Mapping and Orchestration of various underlying technology services
  • Sequencing the migration while considering applications lifecycle and potential end-user impact.
  • Work with the vendor to Produce concrete timelines that encompass fastrack technical deployment and minimum service disruptions.
  • Perform various technical tasks related to Site readiness , Critical Services and Outage windows.
  • Validate that all the foundational network has been established at new Data Center site along with any transport links required for the migration.
  • Identify client resource support needed during planning and execution of the move, and post migration ongoing support in order to adhere to SLAs and KPIs

Lab Migration Activities – Execution
  • Pilot Phase: Relocate a subset of non-critical systems to validate the migration plan and identify unforeseen challenges.
  • Liaise the Graceful shutdown of equipment
  • Lift and shift to new location by Domain basis (Outage window 1 week max per domain)
  • Making sure that Patching and Cabling , label , testing (Count & categorize i.e. Coaxial, ETH, fiber) is as per client's standards (TIA/EIA-568 , ISO/IEC 11801 and ANSI)
  • Power up & restore equipment including applications.
  • Bring on line and ensure traffic flows from Brampton to new location are working
  • Validation of all service flows should be done between Brampton , New site and YM+ Flavelle.
  • Regression testing, Test connectivity, validate service flows, performance, and functionality at the new site
  • Batch Migration: Migrate equipment in logical groups or batches based on dependencies and priority. Start with less critical systems and move toward high-priority ones, ensuring services remain operational during the transition. Final
  • Move remaining critical equipment, ensuring a robust fallback plan.
  • Provide technical guidance during the migration process, addressing any issues or obstacles that may arise.

Lab Migration Activities – Post Migration
  • Conduct post-migration assessments to ensure the successful completion of the migration and verify data integrity and system functionality.
  • Reconnect and Test: Systematically reconnect and test equipment to verify functionality and resolve any issues.
  • Performance Validation: Conduct thorough testing to ensure the environment meets required performance standards and were not damaged in transit.
  • Update documentation and address inefficiencies discovered during the move.
  • Work with vendor to setup VPN access for all client Staff and Vendor teams and must be tested. Access Procedures should be documents shared across teams.
  • Setup Out of the band/Console Access through a secure dedicated access into datacenter network infrastructure in order to administer connected devices and IT assets without using the corporate LAN or during initial installation or outage .

Lab Governance & Documentation
  • Monitor and track the progress of the migration, providing regular updates to stakeholders and project managers.
  • Maintain up-to-date topology diagrams, device configurations, and IP addressing schemas.
  • Create and update runbooks and SOPs for recurring tasks and emergency procedures.
